business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Wholesale Trade of Aged Scotch and Bordeaux Wines

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014; Executive Regulations issued thereunder by the Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Unit (AMLCFTU); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Central Bank of Egypt KYC/AML Instructions for banks and financial institutions; national beneficial ownership registration requirements administered by GAFI.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Country-of-origin Ministry of Interior, Passport Authority, or Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization at Egyptian Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of parent entity

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as required by receiving Egyptian bank

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the Egyptian AMLCFTU national lists, United Nations Security Council sanctions, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated terrorist list, and Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT circulars. Enhanced due diligence is compulsory for PEPs, with senior management approval required for any applicant connected to a PEP. All background checks must be completed and archived in accordance with Law No. 80 of 2002 and CBE KYC rules before incorporation acceptance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Company Registration Portal - 'Invest in Egypt' electronic services platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be submitted and registered in Arabic. Latin-script names may be registered only as an addition to the Arabic name, provided the transliteration is phonetically consistent and the name is distinctive within the Egyptian Companies Register. Names may not imply sovereign, military, religious, or state-sponsored functions without express ministerial authorization.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Alcohol (unless a special alcoholic-beverage license has first been obtained)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File a written administrative objection with the GAFI Name Clearance Committee within 30 calendar days of rejection, attaching the official rejection notice, requested Arabic name and Latin transliteration, and supporting arguments on distinguishability and regulatory license status. If the objection is denied, file an administrative appeal to the Minister of Investment within 60 days, and thereafter, if still unsuccessful, initiate judicial appeal before the Cairo Administrative Court (State Council) within 60 days of the ministerial decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for bonded wine/spirits trade. The statutory license and Egyptian Customs Authority rules require a physical registered office accessible for service of process and regulatory inspection, plus a separately licensed bonded warehouse for excise-controlled stock. A virtual office may only be used for non-core administrative correspondence and cannot replace the physical office mandated by the Investment Law and Customs regulations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (estimated 80-85% likelihood of unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of bonded licence operation due to alcohol excise risk, smuggling exposure, and Ministry of Interior surveillance requirements).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (LLC provisions, Articles 102-112) as amended; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (Article 7, GAFI One-Stop Shop); Customs Law No. 207 of 2020 (bonded warehouses); Excise Tax Law No. 20 of 2020 (alcoholic beverages)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investors Services Center / One-Stop Shop, in coordination with the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation notice and notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al Ta'assess) filed through the GAFI electronic licensing platform
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to the LLC under Companies Law 159/1981; however, at least 50% of the subscribed capital must be deposited upfront into a restricted escrow bank account in Egypt before GAFI issue. The bonded warehouse license additionally requires a customs bank guarantee covering customs duties on spirits/wines, with a commercially recommended solvency minimum of EGP 500,000.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that each founder subscribing to the shares set opposite their name in the Articles of Association approves the allocation of the entire subscribed share capital and confirms that the statutory paid-up deposit has been placed in the company's restricted escrow account in Egypt. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office is fixed at the leased bonded warehouse address specified in the Articles of Association. FURTHER RESOLVED that the General Manager, Financial Officer and Compliance Officer are appointed with authority to act only in accordance with the joint signatory mandate, representation before banks and authorities, and procurement of bonded and alcoholic trade licenses. Execution of this resolution is immediate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Name Reservation and Trade-Name Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Name Reservation Window (electronic portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an Arabic company name, optionally with English transliteration, via the GAFI online name reservation service; verify the name does not conflict with existing Commercial Registry entries or public-order naming restrictions and includes a descriptive activity indicator such as Trading for Bonded Warehousing of Alcoholic Beverages. Receive the automated name reservation certificate before notarization.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a name-objection cure with the GAFI Name Screening Committee within 15 days; select an alternative suffix or transliteration if conflict is confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Association and Capital Deposit Escrow
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cairo Notary Public Office (Ministry of Justice) and a licensed Egyptian commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and sign the Articles of Association before a notary public; authenticate all founders' signatures. Open a temporary escrow bank account in Egypt and deposit not less than 50% of the subscribed capital. Obtain the bank capital deposit certificate to be attached to the incorporation file; for bonded spirits wholesale, the capital evidence must support the later customs guarantee application.
required_dossiers: Founders' passports and corporate personality documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify notarial observations on powers of attorney within 10 working days; if the bank queries source of funds, submit an AML/CFT declaration and a bank reference letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Statutory Incorporation and Automatic Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investors Services Center (One-Stop Shop registry window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles of Association, capital deposit certificate, founders' forms and First Board Resolution through the GAFI One-Stop Shop. GAFI performs statutory screening under Companies Law 159/1981 and Investment Law 72/2017; upon approval it issues the incorporation certificate and simultaneously registers the company in the Commercial Registry, generating the Commercial Registry number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply to the GAFI Grievance Committee within 30 days; cure shareholder eligibility issues by filing corrected declarations and legalizing apostilled foreign documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Card, VAT and Excise Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and the National Social Insurance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the tax card application at the competent ETA branch corresponding to the registered office; file VAT registration and the excise account declaration under Excise Tax Law 20/2020 for spirits and wines. Register the company as an employer with the social insurance authorities and align payroll records with the bonded trade headcount.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer ETA queries by producing the accounting plan and physical warehouse lease; file a late-registration relief request if the SLA is exceeded due to agency delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Alcoholic Beverages Bonded Warehouse and Trade License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Customs Authority (Bonded Warehouse Licensing Division) and Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade - Alcoholic Beverages Trade Control
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the customs bonded warehouse license application under Customs Law 207/2020, enclosing the warehouse lease or title deed, site layout, fire safety approvals, insurance coverage and a customs bank guarantee. Obtain the supplementary wholesale trade license for alcoholic beverages; maintain bonded stock records for aged Scotch and Bordeaux wines with quarterly stock audits to customs.
required_dossiers: Warehouse lease deed or proof of title
Fire safety and civil defense certificates
Stock record and internal control manual
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to customs queries on the bonded premises within 20 days; amend security and layout, increase the guarantee, or resubmit after internal control manual revision; administrative appeal lies to the Customs Authority Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment Registration and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Central Department of EIA; Civil Defense Directorate; competent municipality
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the environmental registration form for a dry bonded warehouse with no manufacturing discharge; submit the waste management and spill response plan and obtain EEAA registration approval. Thereafter apply for the Civil Defense fire safety certificate under Law 453/1954, undergo structural load inspection of storage areas, and receive the workplace clearance under Labor Law 12/2003.
required_dossiers: Waste management and spill response plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify EEAA observations on spill containment or ventilation within 15 days; upgrade passive fire protection and arrange civil defense re-inspection; if structural deficiencies are identified, submit an engineering strengthening design for municipal approval.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Egyptian Customs Authority (Bonded Warehousing Directorate) and Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade - Alcoholic Beverages Licensing Unit
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Alcoholic Beverages Bonded Warehouse and Wholesale Trade License under Customs Law 207/2020, together with the Alcoholic Beverages Trade Permit issued by the Ministry of Supply

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration / Screening; a full EIA report is not required for a storage-only bonded warehouse, subject to approval of the waste management and spill-control plan
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended and its Executive Regulations: no untreated wastewater discharge into public sewer (BOD <= 300 mg/L, COD <= 600 mg/L, TSS <= 350 mg/L, pH 6.0-9.5 per Decree 44/2000); no fugitive VOC or flammable vapor release from sealed spirit storage; spent spirits and chemical residues classified as hazardous waste under Regulation No. 477/1998 with certified disposal manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification by the Civil Defense Directorate under Law No. 453/1954 covering alarm systems, approved extinguishers, hydrant networks and passive fire separation for high-stack storage; municipal structural load inspection of racking and mezzanine areas; occupational clearance under Labor Law No. 12/2003 covering lighting, ventilation, evacuation routes and employee safety registration.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance — central portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; mandatory e-invoicing platform: https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Register under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 90 of 2021 within 30 days of commercial registry issuance. A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must submit the notarized and Arabic-translated Memorandum of Association, Commercial Register extract, power of attorney for the legal representative, passport copies of shareholders/managers, and proof of the licensed bonded warehouse premises. The ETA then issues the Tax Identification Number (TIN) and digitized Tax Card. Separately, the entity must file VAT registration once annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000 (mandatory) or EGP 50,000 (voluntary), and must complete e-invoicing activation in the ETA roll-out wave applicable to wholesale bonded trade.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. Statutory elections include: (i) fiscal unity / tax group consolidation for wholly-owned Egyptian subsidiaries under Law No. 90 of 2021; (ii) Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 election between accelerated depreciation and investment-cost deduction for eligible licensed projects; (iii) elective carryforward or refund treatment of input VAT credits under Law No. 67 of 2016; and (iv) election to treat inventory and bonded stock under the customs duty-suspension regime rather than local free circulation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT under Law No. 67 of 2016, supplemented by stamp duty; Egypt does not operate a GST or US-style sales tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration when annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000; voluntary registration from EGP 50,000. Non-resident suppliers of digital or offshore services to Egyptian consumers are registrable irrespective of turnover. A bonded wholesale operator additionally requires a Customs bonded-warehouse license and registration on the Customs Authority's ACI/CargoX platform for cross-border movements.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing applies to all VAT-registered taxpayers on a phased roll-out. Each invoice must be created in the ETA-specified JSON/XML format, transmitted in near-real time via the ETA invoicing portal or certified API, validated by the ETA fiscal clearance engine to obtain a Universal Identification Code (UIC), and printed with a digital stamp / QR code. Rejected or untransmitted invoices are non-deductible and expose the taxpayer to escalating daily administrative fines, suspension of the TIN and e-invoicing account, and loss of input VAT credit in audits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Article 31 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 when: (1) the wine/spirits are physically exported outside Egypt and title passes to a non-resident buyer; (2) the exporter holds a valid Egyptian TIN and VAT registration; (3) export proceeds are credited to an Egyptian bank account in freely convertible foreign currency; (4) the e-invoice is cleared by the ETA and the customs export declaration is finalized by the Customs Authority; and (5) goods depart from the bonded warehouse without entry into local free circulation, under a Customs re-export or transfer authorization within the statutory shipping period. International transport and directly related export services may also be zero-rated. Exports from bonded storage are relieved from VAT, customs duty, and excise-equivalent charges, subject to full documentary traceability.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Declaration filed via the Customs Authority/ACI system)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing foreign-currency export proceeds
Bonded warehouse release / re-export authorization issued by Egyptian Customs for the specific consignment
ETA-validated electronic export invoice bearing the UIC and QR digital stamp
Certificate of Origin where required by the destination customs regime
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA and Customs Authority conduct joint targeted audits that cross-match e-invoice data, customs export declarations, warehouse movement records, and bank forex receipts. Fraudulent export zero-rating, forged transport documents, or non-repatriated proceeds trigger: a fine of 100% to 300% of the VAT evaded under Law No. 67 of 2016; full retrospective clawback of refunds with monthly late-payment interest; imprisonment for willful evasion under Law No. 90 of 2021; suspension or cancellation of the TIN and bonded-warehouse license; and personal liability of directors and legal representatives. Refund claims are risk-scored and selectively subjected to document-integrity validation before any credit or cash settlement.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting as the national monetary authority and foreign-exchange regulator under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains current-account convertibility consistent with IMF Article VIII obligations, but capital-account transactions remain subject to CBE and GAFI registration and approval. For the bonded wine and spirits wholesale business, imported goods are treated as normal merchandise trade once the customs declaration, certificate of origin, commercial invoice, and excise-duty requirements are satisfied. Profit remittances by the Egyptian LLC to foreign shareholders are permitted through a licensed bank, provided the shareholder records are updated at GAFI, audited financial statements are filed, corporate tax returns are assessed, and a valid tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority is available. Following the 2024 unified exchange-rate reform, interbank rates apply to inward remittances and trade settlements; no parallel exchange premium is recognised for banking purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no current mandatory conversion ratio in force for export proceeds; the exporter may retain 100% of export receipts in a foreign-currency account maintained with a CBE-licensed bank. Export proceeds must be repatriated to Egypt within the payment term approved in the export documentary collection order or sales contract, generally no later than 180 days from the bill-of-lading date for wine and spirits consignments, unless the bank and CBE approve an extended open-account period. The bank is required to match incoming proceeds against the export customs release and report collection to the CBE. Optional conversion to EGP is executed at the prevailing interbank rate; parallel-market sales and transit-account netting are prohibited.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account; Operational Foreign-Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account; Operational Account; Trade Finance Line
Operational Account; FX Trading Account; Letter-of-Credit Account
Operational Account; EGP Clearing Account; Import Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: LOW - Egypt does not grant standalone Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licences to foreign or offshore digital banks. An overseas EMI cannot hold a CBE-regulated nostro account, issue an Egyptian IBAN, or settle bonded-warehouse customs transactions without a fully licensed local Egyptian bank sponsor. Such platforms may function only as a front-end payment instrument for customer journeys, while the actual cash clearing, FX conversion, and escrow must sit with a licensed tier-1 Egyptian bank. For this medium-risk bonded trade, treasury should not treat offshore EMI balances as eligible for capital escrow, customs guarantees, or excise settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is effectively mandatory for the primary corporate signatory and for any non-resident director or ultimate beneficial owner during initial account opening. Egyptian AML and counter-terrorist financing regulations under Law No. 80 of 2002 and CBE instructions require the licensed bank to verify original identification documents, corporate registry extracts, commercial registration, tax card, capital structure, and beneficial-ownership declarations. Remote video KYC may reduce friction, but is generally accepted only after the client has an existing relationship with the bank or when the ultimate beneficial owner executes a notarised power of attorney in favour of an Egyptian resident authorised signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wine and spirits bonded-warehouse trade may be classified as a high-risk excise-sensitive sector requiring enhanced transaction monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Egyptian Customs Authority bonded-warehouse licence; Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade licence for alcohol trading; excise tax registration; warehouse inventory ledger; annual stock audit certificate; customs movement guarantees; purchase invoices; sales invoices; transfer release orders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders or foreign ultimate beneficial owners without an Egyptian tax footprint or landed immigration status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate and company license; notarised board resolution; power of attorney for Egyptian resident representative; shareholders register; individual passport and proof-of-address; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; audited group financial statements; bank references from the foreign home bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Telegraphic-transfer mismatches, consecutive round-tripping, or parent-supplier payments not aligned with customs invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bonded trade sale and purchase contracts; commercial invoices; bills of lading or CMRs; FCOs; CargoX/Advance Cargo Information declarations; customs release returns; bank MT103 confirmation; import and export customs entries; CBE trade-matching documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed persons (PEPs), senior public officials, or family members appearing among shareholders, distributors, or beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent PEP screening reports; board resolution approving the relationship; written AML compliance approval; nature of business justification; ongoing enhanced monitoring arrangements; source-of-wealth declaration; corporate beneficial-ownership registry extract.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital for the Egyptian LLC must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the foreign shareholder's bank directly to the designated Egyptian licensed bank corresponding account in USD or EUR. The SWIFT payment must identify the Egyptian LLC and use a clear purpose clause such as 'CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION - EG_LLC - GAFI REGISTRATION NO.'; the receiving bank will capture the CBE foreign-investment identification code and report the transaction to the Central Bank of Egypt. The required verification bundle includes: certified certificate of incorporation and commercial registry extract; GAFI registration or investment appraisal approval; notarised English/Arabic board resolution authorising the capital call; share subscription documents; audited financial statements or source-of-funds evidence for the remitting shareholder; and bank KYC forms. Upon receipt, the bank may hold the funds in a capital escrow account until the LLC's capital declaration and CBE paperwork are completed, after which the funds are released to the operational account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: International supplier settlements for aged scotch, bordeaux wine, and warehouse replenishment will run through standard SWIFT clearing rails: MT103 for open-account supplier invoices, MT700/MT760 letters of credit for documentary purchases and standby guarantees where the winery requires payment security, and MT202 for interbank covering instructions when same-day value is needed. Local Egyptian bonded transfers are cleared through the CBE RTGS system in EGP where the seller and buyer maintain domestic accounts, accompanied by customs bonded-warehouse transfer forms and excise movement documentation. For direct commercial imports, the Egyptian bank may issue an irrevocable commercial letter of credit against customs import approval, certificate of origin, shipping documents, sanitary and halal certification where applicable, and the CargoX ACI customs message.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forward contracts (USD/EGP and EUR/EGP) transacted with CBE-licensed banks, supported by genuine underlying wine/spirits import or export trade documents.
FX swaps between USD/EUR and EGP executed through the Egyptian interbank market, used to bridge short-term liquidity mismatches between foreign-currency payables and EGP customs/excise obligations.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for medium-term foreign-currency financing of bonded stock, subject to bank credit committee approval and CBE reporting thresholds.
Foreign-currency option strategies, including simple European-style USD/EGP options, where offered by a CBE-licensed bank and clearly linked to a committed trade transaction.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not an onshore Egyptian hedging instrument; an offshore parent may use NDF cash settlements solely as an internal treasury overlay, without recognising the NDF as a permissible Egyptian tax or regulatory hedge.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Commercial Registry / GAFI One-Stop Shop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 March for the calendar year; the registered certificate must be renewed before expiry.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative late fee; continued non-renewal may result in temporary suspension and eventual administrative strike-off from the Commercial Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March; the renewed tax card must remain in effect for the current tax year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under the Egyptian Tax Procedures Law; an expired tax card may block customs transactions, bank clearances, and Commercial Registry renewals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return and Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, filing and payment are due by 30 April, with quarterly prepayments during the year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory delay interest and late-filing penalties on the attributable tax; prolonged default may trigger enforced collection, suspension of tax clearance, and blockage of customs and Commercial Registry processes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI / Egyptian Commercial Registry; AML oversight by the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing Combating Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually as part of the Commercial Registry renewal and within 30 days after any direct or indirect beneficial ownership or shareholding transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Anti-Money Laundering Law 80/2002, as amended; persistent non-maintenance of UBO data may lead to suspension or strike-off of the corporate registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application must be submitted at least 30 days before the annual expiry date of the bonded warehouse license; the license must remain in force for lawful bonded operations.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operation after expiry is treated as unauthorized warehousing; goods may be seized, customs fines imposed, and the bonded operating license revoked.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Adoption and GAFI/ETA Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary shareholders meeting must be convened within six months of the fiscal year-end; audited financial statements must be filed with GAFI and ETA no later than the corporate income tax return deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Corporate-law fines against managers for failure to hold the shareholders meeting; non-filing may prevent dividend distributions and trigger an ETA non-compliance flag.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs are required to appoint an Egyptian-licensed auditor and produce audited annual financial statements under Companies Law 159/1981 and the Egyptian Tax Law; there is no size-based exemption for a limited liability company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially converged with IFRS; statutory books, tax accounts, and financial statements are maintained in Egyptian pounds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a beneficial ownership register and confirm its accuracy annually during the Commercial Registry renewal. Any shareholding transfer must first be recorded in the statutory Register of Members, followed by a UBO update notice to GAFI/Commercial Registry within 30 days of the transfer. Failure to maintain current UBO data is treated as an AML compliance violation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400–1,000 per year in Cairo/Giza; USD 600–1,400 if the agent also handles bonded customs liaison and statutory records.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–4,000 for a wine and spirits bonded-warehouse LLC; increases with inventory volume and customs/excise stock reconciliation requirements.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (Income Tax Law No. 91/2005, art. 7, as amended by Law No. 16/2020)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% CIT for licensed Free Zone projects, replaced by an annual charge of 1-2% on the value of goods entering the zone; investment-cost deduction of 30-50% under Investment Law No. 72/2017 for eligible industrial, logistic and bonded-trade projects; SMEs may elect a simplified turnover-based tax at 0.4%-1.0% of gross revenue under Law 191/2015, subject to eligibility caps.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 19 (Corporate Income Tax Return for juridical persons); submitted electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal at www.inata.gov.eg.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months from the end of the tax year; for a December 31 fiscal year-end, the return is due on April 30 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: unified tax number, commercial register number, tax card issue data, primary revenue tax office code, and company legal form.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the local LLC's unified tax number; the foreign parent's Egyptian branch or tax registration, if any, must be cross-referenced to the LLC file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit or loss before income tax per the audited financial statements prepared under Egyptian Accounting Standards, including reconciliation of the accounting profit to the tax base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the statutory audit report signed by an Egyptian licensed CPA; the foreign parent's consolidation schedules do not replace the local standalone statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back provisions exceeding legally permissible caps, unallocated general and administrative fees, entertainment above 1% of turnover, unapproved donations, fines, and penalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Group management fees, trademark licenses, and notional service charges paid to the non-resident parent are deductible only if arm's-length, contractually documented, and supported by transfer-pricing benchmarking; otherwise they are reclassified as non-deductible distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct dividends received from Egyptian resident juridical persons, Egyptian government bond interest, certain capital gains on listed securities, and income exempt under an applicable DTA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign dividends may be exempted or credited only under the applicable DTA; attach the Tax Residency Certificate and evidence of foreign tax paid.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct prior-year tax losses carried forward within the 5-year statutory window, provided each loss year was declared in a timely return and accepted by the ETA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: In the first two years of the newly incorporated LLC, leave blank; losses of a foreign parent branch are not transferable to the Egyptian LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net adjusted taxable profit after add-backs, exemptions, and loss deductions; this base is subject to the headline CIT rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify that excise duties on alcoholic beverages borne by the LLC are not deducted; excise and customs duties are not deductible expenses for CIT purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed corporate income tax at the statutory 22.5% rate on the taxable income in Box 5.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the LLC operates in a Free Zone or holds an Investment Law incentive certificate, apply the certified reduced rate and upload the incentive approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct quarterly CIT installments paid, payroll tax credits, and foreign tax credits limited to the Egyptian tax attributable to the foreign income under the relevant DTA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim foreign tax credits only for taxes paid in a jurisdiction with which Egypt has a DTA; unilateral credit is not available for non-treaty countries.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance due after offsetting credits and prepayments; payment is made through the ETA treasury collection system.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settle the net tax due before declaring any dividend; undistributed profits retained without settlement may be treated as deemed constructive distributions to the foreign shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of completeness and accuracy signed by the LLC's legal representative (general manager or chairman) and the licensed tax accountant, with the corporate seal affixed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must hold a valid notarized power of attorney authorizing the local manager to sign; lack of authority renders the return inadmissible.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine of EGP 5,000 to 20,000 under art. 133 of Law No. 91/2005, plus a delay surcharge of 2% per month on the unpaid tax due until full settlement; persistent non-filing triggers the ETA's discretionary assessment, suspension of the commercial license, and criminal evasion proceedings if intent is proven.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 21 (Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form); attached to Form No. 19 and submitted via the same ETA e-filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same statutory deadline as Form No. 19 (within 4 months after the fiscal year-end); separate late submission is treated as non-filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of all transactions with related parties: type, volume, value, currency, and counterparty characteristics; for bonded trade, report international purchases of Scotch and Bordeaux stock, storage fees, logistics, and insurance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report cross-border purchases from the non-resident parent or affiliate at arm's-length purchase prices; customs duty and excise paid at importation must be shown separately from the transfer price.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B - Transfer pricing method per transaction
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the selected OECD-aligned method for each controlled transaction and the reason for its selection, including economic analysis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a wholesale distribution entity (bonded trader), TNMM is the most appropriate with net operating margin on sales as the profit level indicator; document the position against independent wine and spirits wholesalers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interquartile range of comparables obtained from acceptable databases (e.g., Orbis, MTP), selection of tested party, and positioning of the taxpayer's actual result within the range.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prefer Egyptian and Middle East/North Africa wholesale comparables; where no local comparables exist, use Mediterranean or European distributors and justify geographic adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D - Master File / Local File readiness
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the Master File, Local File, and (if applicable) Country-by-Country Report are prepared and physically available for submission within 30 days upon the ETA's request.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: When annual controlled transactions exceed EGP 10,000,000, prepare both files in Arabic or English; the ETA may require the ultimate parent to submit group data when consolidated revenue exceeds the OECD EUR 750 million threshold.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file Form No. 21 or refusal to produce TP documentation triggers a deemed-non-arm's-length reassessment, addition of the full transaction margin to taxable profits, the 2% monthly delay surcharge, and administrative fines; the burden of proof shifts to the taxpayer.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividend distributions paid by Egyptian juridical persons to resident and non-resident shareholders (Income Tax Law No. 91/2005, art. 42); no additional attributable tax applies to the shareholder.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must: (i) obtain an annual Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the treaty jurisdiction's competent authority; (ii) notarize and legalize or apostille the TRC and provide an Arabic translation if required; (iii) file a written application for treaty relief with the ETA's Central Department for International Agreements, attaching constitutional documents, shareholding evidence, and a beneficial-ownership declaration; (iv) obtain the ETA's approval before the distribution date so the reduced rate is applied at source. A conduit company without economic substance, financial capacity, or decision-making will be denied relief under the beneficial-ownership test; over-withheld tax may be reclaimed by refund application within 5 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Debt interest: statutory WHT of 20% on gross interest paid to non-residents; treaty rates are commonly reduced to 10-15% (e.g., China 10%, France 15%, UK 15%). IP royalties and license fees: statutory WHT of 20% on gross royalties; common treaty rates are 8-15% (e.g., China 8% for industrial royalties and 10% for cultural rights; France and UK 15%). For the bonded wine and spirits trade, trademark or distribution-rights royalties paid to the foreign parent must be supported by an IP license registered with the Egyptian Patents and Trademarks Office; back-to-back royalty schemes with no local value creation will be recharacterized as dividends and taxed at 10% or denied deduction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10,000,000 of annual controlled related-party transactions (per ETA Decree No. 146/2019 and the ETA Transfer Pricing Guidelines) triggers mandatory preparation of the Local File and Master File, available within 30 days of a formal request; Form No. 21 must be filed with the annual CIT return regardless of the threshold; Country-by-Country Reporting is required when the ultimate parent's consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not maintain a standalone Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) statute comparable to the UAE; however, functionality-equivalent substance obligations arise from the GAAR in art. 90 of Law No. 91/2005, treaty beneficial-ownership rules, and the Investment Law incentives. A bonded wine and spirits LLC must demonstrate a licensed and operating customs warehouse in Egypt, permanent staff and payroll, physical premises, board decisions taken in Egypt, and active inventory control; otherwise the ETA and the General Authority for Investment can recharacterize the entity as a mere shell, deny treaty benefits and free-zone incentives, impose deemed profits, and recommend license cancellation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional under-declaration of bonded warehouse sales, off-book cash transactions, false purchase invoices for wine and spirits, double accounting records, or submission of materially false Form No. 19 declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine of EGP 10,000 to 100,000 and imprisonment of 6 months to 5 years under art. 121 of Law No. 91/2005; confiscation of assets; recovery of the entire unpaid tax plus the 2% monthly delay surcharge, capped at 100% of the tax; permanent closure of the bonded facility and revocation of the alcohol trading license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, general managers, and the tax accountant are jointly and severally liable for the tax debt and civil restitution; travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and criminal sentences of up to 5 years are imposed when the evasion is attributable to their direction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare Local File / Master File for controlled transactions above EGP 10,000,000 per annum, omission of Form No. 21, absence of benchmarking evidence, or systematic under-pricing of imported Scotch and Bordeaux stock from the foreign parent to shift profits offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA re-determination of the arm's-length price with full add-back of the adjusted margin to taxable profits; assessed interest at 2% per month on the additional CIT; administrative penalties and, in repeated cases, the same criminal evasion sanction as fraudulent understatement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the inaccurate return or directed the mispricing are personally liable for the additional tax, interest, and penalties; they may be prosecuted for complicity in tax evasion and prohibited from leaving Egypt pending settlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Bonded customs regime and excise smuggling
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Removal of bonded wine or spirits into the Egyptian domestic market without payment of customs duty and excise taxes; falsification of warehouse inventory records; unauthorized re-grading, substitution, or rationing of stock; bribery of customs officers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Customs fines up to 100% to 1,000% of the evaded duty under Customs Law No. 207/2020, confiscation and destruction of goods, revocation and permanent closure of the bonded warehouse license, and criminal penalties for smuggling with imprisonment from 1 to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The warehouse licensee, board members, and the managing director are jointly and severally liable for the evaded customs duty and excise; personal fines equal to the total evaded amount, asset freezes, and imprisonment sentences are routinely imposed.
